Why it matters

This platform gives STEG's National Dispatching visibility into decentralized rooftop solar production it currently can't see — improving net-load forecasts, reserve sizing, and grid flexibility.

Backtest: our model vs. baselines

By forecast horizon — computed, not assumed
backtest
nRMSE = error as % of total installed capacity, lower is better. Coverage = share of actual outcomes falling inside the P10–P90 band (target ≈ 80%).

Reserve recommendation

Hours in the next 72h where forecast uncertainty is wide enough to warrant extra spinning reserve
decision support
Flagged when the P10–P90 band exceeds 25% of the median forecast — a simple, transparent rule a dispatcher can audit, not a black-box score.
